title: Class booking confirmed
description: Confirm a gym or studio class spot with class name, trainer and time. Booking confirmation WhatsApp template for fitness studios.
notes: Include your late-cancel window in the body; it is the most common support question.

body.text: You're in, {{first_name}}! Your spot in *{{class_name}}* with {{trainer}} is confirmed for {{day}} at {{time}}. We can't wait to see you, and we'll send a reminder before the day.
